reviewNote: Official DOSM, SingStat, Vietnam NSO and Philippine Statistics Authority releases first reviewed on 18 October 2026, the date in this header. A series reviewed again carries its own reviewedAt, the time its official page was read, and sourceNotes quoting that page. These are manually reviewed public release observations, not automatic feeds. Assembly does not renew any review date. Automatic historical sources remain separate. A release date is null where it could not be confirmed on the reviewed page. No original publication date is inferred for revised past quarters.

series.sourceNotes: SingStat news release "METI Upgrades GDP Growth Forecast for 2026 to 'Around 6.0 Per Cent' and Forecasts GDP Growth of '2.5 to 4.5 Per Cent' for 2027", Published 24 Nov 2026: "The Singapore economy grew by 6.1% on a year-on-year basis in 3Q 2026." Headline year-on-year GDP growth (the page notes headline growth is generally in real terms), not the 'around 6.0%' forecast for 2026. Replaces the 5.4% advance estimate released on 14 October 2026.

DOSM release "Gross Domestic Product Third Quarter 2026", Latest Release: 18 November 2026: "Malaysia's economy expanded by 5.5 per cent in the third quarter of 2026, following growth of 6.0 per cent in the preceding quarter." Year-on-year growth, not the 1.5% quarter-on-quarter seasonally adjusted rate or the 5.6% growth of the first nine months. Replaces the 5.3% advance estimate of 16 October 2026, whose release named 18 November 2026 as the date of the actual third-quarter GDP. The OpenDOSM GDP dashboard shows the same 5.5% (last updated 18 Nov 2026, next update 17 Feb 2027).

NSO press release on the socio-economic situation in the third quarter and nine months of 2026, page date "NGÀY ĐĂNG: 03/10/2026" (posted 3 October 2026; releasedAt): "Tổng sản phẩm trong nước (GDP) quý III/2026 ước tăng 9,95% so với cùng kỳ năm trước" (third-quarter GDP estimated 9.95% higher than a year earlier). Rechecked on 27 November 2026: the October 2026 monthly report, issued 3 November 2026, gives no revised third-quarter figure, so the estimate stands.

NSO "Consumer Price Index (CPI), Gold Price Index and US Dollar Price Index in October and ten months of 2026", REFERENCE PERIOD 10/2026, DATE OF ISSUE 03/11/2026: "The Consumer Price Index (CPI) in October increased by 0.20% compared to the previous month, rose by 4.41% compared to December 2025, and increased by 5.09% over the same period last year." Year-on-year rate, not the monthly change, the change since December 2025, the 4.57% ten-month average or the 4.24% core inflation. Earlier review: 5.08 for September 2026, from the third-quarter press release.

PSA "Summary Inflation Report Consumer Price Index (2018=100): October 2026", Release Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026, Reference Number 2026-351. Table A. Year-on-Year Inflation Rates, All Items, row Philippines Headline, column October 2026: 7.8; the text reads "The Philippines' headline inflation or overall inflation accelerated to 7.8 percent in October 2026". Not core (5.4), NCR (5.9), areas outside NCR (8.2) or the 5.6 year-to-date average. The same table keeps September 2026 at 7.2, not revised. Earlier review: 7.2 for September 2026 (release of 6 October 2026).
